aliases: RENPHO AI-powered exercise bike R-Q002 N

discovery.none: Manual selection only. No reliable advertised local name was established, and generic FTMS must not claim every treadmill or bike in range. After the owner selects an R-Q002 N, enumerate GATT and validate the captured Indoor Bike Data dialect before exposing the RENPHO resistance profile.

identification.notes: No safe automatic identity signal is documented. FTMS is a shared service, not unique RENPHO identification, and is deliberately absent from matching. After an owner selects an R-Q002 N, corroborate the Indoor Bike Data dialect and never apply this resistance scale to other FTMS bikes.

device.name: RENPHO R-Q002 N exercise bike (read-only)
device.notes:
Phone-direct standard BLE telemetry, with no proprietary UART requirement, account, cloud ride session or provisioning exchange. The main stream is standard FTMS Indoor Bike Data with a model-specific resistance profile: raw resistance is read as SIGNED int16 and divided by two. Instantaneous and average power remain SIGNED int16 values in watts, even though the reviewed open driver reads instantaneous power unsigned.
Consumer integration is identify_only: no dedicated R-Q002 FTMS/CSC handler ships here. The protocol blocks and stdlib vectors preserve implementation facts, not live app telemetry; supported status requires that handler.
FTMS fields are flag-driven and little-endian. Instantaneous speed is present when More Data (flag bit 0) is clear. The expended-energy group is FIVE bytes: total energy u16, energy/hour u16, energy/minute u8. Advancing only two bytes would shift heart rate and every following field.
CAPTURE BOUNDARY: the public capture contains FTMS 0x1826 and Cycling Power Service 0x1818. The open driver also subscribes to CSC 0x1816, so CSC is documented as a conditional standard read-only endpoint, not as something proven by that capture. Other RENPHO bikes, RENPHO scales and the separate health apps are outside this spec.
READ ONLY: the FTMS Control Point and Cycling Power Control Point are listed only so a client can avoid them. No request-control, resistance, ERG, start, stop, calibration, firmware or session write is declared.

openness.notes: Standard Bluetooth services are open. The R-Q002 resistance scale and capture quirks are interoperability evidence from the public QZ driver, not a vendor-published profile. The shared ftms-fitness-machine-service reference spec is not modified.

enter_pairing_mode.notes: The reviewed local driver uses ordinary GATT without a proprietary enrolment or pairing exchange.

exclusivity.recovery: Close competing fitness apps, then reconnect; no pairing record is needed by this profile.

unpair.notes: No bond is created by this read-only client path.

credentials.notes: No API key, ride credential or application authentication is needed for the telemetry documented here.

factory_reset.description: Do not treat stopping a ride, deleting an OS bond or power-cycling the console as a factory reset. No exact manual was acquired.
factory_reset.effect: No factory-reset sequence or cleared-state list was established for the R-Q002 N.

methods.description: Connect without a vendor account and subscribe only to standard telemetry.
methods.name: Direct standard FTMS/CSC telemetry

steps.action: Select an R-Q002 N candidate and close other fitness apps that may hold its BLE link.
Connect and enumerate FTMS, Cycling Power and, if actually present, CSC endpoints.
steps.expect: FTMS Indoor Bike Data is present; Cycling Power is capture-backed; CSC is optional and source-reported.
Flag-driven telemetry arrives without any Control Point write.

steps.action: Parse Indoor Bike Data using protocol_details.indoor_bike_data and require exact consumption of all declared fields.
steps.expect: The public vector decodes to 3.60 km/h, 53 rpm, raw resistance 131 / normalized 65.5 and 73 W.

setup.notes: Nothing is provisioned. Connect and subscribe to supported standard telemetry characteristics. The public capture and open driver provide medium confidence; no exact setup or pairing flow was run here.

rejoin.notes: BLE only: there is no bike network membership or account binding in this read-only path. Disconnect the old central and reconnect.

steps.action: Disconnect the previous client and any vendor/fitness app.
Reconnect and re-enumerate the standard services; do not send a Control Point operation.

testing.notes: No hardware was driven by this project. The public issue-2401 HCI capture confirms FTMS Indoor Bike Data flags 0x0064 and the Cycling Power Service on this model. CSC 0x1816 is source-reported by the open driver but is not present in that capture; it remains conditional on actual enumeration. Workout identifiers and addresses were not retained.

entities.name: Cycling Power
entities.notes: Separate capture-confirmed Cycling Power Service stream, not a duplicate CSC claim.

entities.name: FTMS Distance

artifacts.description: FTMS Indoor Bike Data and Cycling Power Service evidence; sanitized derived vector only.
artifacts.obtained_via: Public GitHub issue attachment, reviewed offline

evidence.open_questions: Validate CSC behavior and the one captured Cycling Power Measurement's trailing byte, then confirm all power values against a second meter. No exact R-Q002 N manual was acquired.
evidence.public_capture: cagnulein/qdomyos-zwift issue 2401, 2024-06-22, contains an R-Q002 N HCI capture. Offline review found 1,883 Indoor Bike Data notifications, all flags 0x0064 and length 10. The included sample was derived without owner identifiers. The capture also enumerates Cycling Power Service 0x1818 and does not contain CSC 0x1816.
evidence.public_implementation: QZ renphobike at afd4f90db35ed7ee29c76a6c19b84de4cf558922 supplied the model-specific resistance /2, flag order, five-byte energy group and CSC subscription behavior. Its unsigned instantaneous-power simplification is deliberately corrected to the signed standard type.

csc_measurement.description: Conditional standard CSC decode. Flags are uint8 at offset 0 and optional data begins at offset 1. Bit 0 adds cumulative wheel revolutions u32 LE and last wheel event time u16 LE; bit 1 adds cumulative crank revolutions u16 LE and last crank event time u16 LE. Event-time scale is 1/1024 second. Reject unsupported flag bits, trailing bytes and truncation in either group.

indoor_bike_data.description: Flags are uint16 little-endian. Consume fields in the order below when each flag is present, except instantaneous speed which is present when bit 0 is CLEAR. Reject truncation. Unknown/reserved flag bits and trailing bytes must stop publication rather than be silently reinterpreted.

fields.fields: total_energy u16 LE kcal; energy_per_hour u16 LE kcal/h; energy_per_minute u8 kcal/min
fields.name: expended_energy_group

indoor_bike_data.missing_distance: Accept device distance only when flag bit 4 is present. A host may integrate speed locally when absent, but must label that value as host- estimated rather than device-reported distance.

public_capture_vector.provenance: One Indoor Bike Data notification from public QZ issue 2401; no address or workout identifier included.

indoor_bike_data.resistance_profile: resistance_raw is retained as a signed int16 and the R-Q002 normalized value is raw / 2, including negative synthetic values. Do not apply the optional user-interface doubling in the open driver, and do not reconcile physical knob changes into automatic writes.

synthetic_full_vector.provenance: Computed to prove signed power, the five-byte energy group and every optional-field offset; not represented as a capture.

synthetic_negative_resistance_vector.provenance: Synthetic standards-type check for signed int16 resistance; not a claimed observed physical resistance.

remaining_unknowns: CSC 0x1816 is source-reported but absent from the public R-Q002 capture; whether another firmware provides it is unknown.
The single captured Cycling Power Measurement has 15 bytes with flags 0x30 and all zero fields; one trailing byte is unexplained and not decoded.
Negative power and negative resistance were not observed in the public stream; their signed int16 types are standards-based and covered by synthetic vectors, not claims about physical ranges.
Exact advertised local name, factory reset, bonding behavior and manual-specific setup instructions.
Control Point behavior, resistance ranges, calibration, firmware update and all writes remain unimplemented.

characteristics.name: Fitness Machine Feature
characteristics.notes: Read-only feature bits; do not infer that a feature is safe to control from its presence.

characteristics.name: Indoor Bike Data
characteristics.notes: Dynamic flag-driven payload; decode with protocol_details.indoor_bike_data, not a fixed offset table. Public capture uses flags 0x0064: speed, instantaneous cadence, resistance and instantaneous power.

characteristics.name: Training Status
characteristics.notes: Standard status endpoint; no device-specific status opcode is asserted.

characteristics.name: Fitness Machine Control Point (do not use)
characteristics.notes: Discovered by the public driver but deliberately not exercised by this read-only spec. No commands are declared.

services.name: Fitness Machine Service
services.notes: Standard FTMS. Indoor Bike Data is the capture-backed primary telemetry stream.

format.name: cps_flags
format.notes: Bit 4 wheel-revolution data; bit 5 crank-revolution data. Other bits follow the standard.

characteristics.name: Cycling Power Measurement
characteristics.notes: Instantaneous power is always a signed int16 little-endian at offset 2; later optional fields depend on flags at offset 0.

characteristics.name: Cycling Power Control Point (do not use)
characteristics.notes: Present in the capture's GATT enumeration; no operation is declared or tested.

services.name: Cycling Power Service (capture-confirmed)
services.notes: Present in the R-Q002 public capture. This is not CSC 0x1816.

characteristics.name: CSC Measurement
characteristics.notes: Standard flags: bit 0 adds wheel revolutions u32 + event time u16; bit 1 adds crank revolutions u16 + event time u16, all little-endian. Event times are 1/1024 s.

services.name: Cycling Speed and Cadence Service (conditional)
services.notes: Source-reported by the open driver, which subscribes to CSC when present. The R-Q002 issue-2401 capture does NOT contain this service. Enumerate before use and do not describe it as capture-confirmed.
